title: discern setup config document

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by discern.

version.description: Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 2.

slug.description: Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

brief.description: Free-text description of what the project is.

agents.description: Which agent integrations to enable: claude_code -> CLAUDE.md, gemini -> GEMINI.md, codex / cursor / copilot -> AGENTS.md.

map.description: [map] settings — chiefly the project-relative directory holding discern's agent documentation tree.

dir.description: Where the project map lives, relative to the project root. `discern setup begin` scaffolds it here and `discern map` browses it.

required_contexts.description: Execution contexts required for each obligation unless it declares its own contexts.

concurrency.description: Maximum live candidate executions across the repository queue.

lookahead.description: Maximum speculative positions beyond the next authorized source; requires an eligible released environment.

completion.description: Complete evidence and repository queue capacity.

kind.description: Borrow a released source checkout or execute in separately owned isolation.

prepare.description: Prepare the candidate state and declared resources before validation.

restore.description: Restore the source state and resources after borrowed execution; required for borrowing.

reset.description: Reset reusable isolation before another execution.

dispose.description: Dispose of owned isolated resources after execution; required for isolation.

reusable.description: Whether the environment supports reuse after its verified return procedure.

resources.description: Declared worktree resource names affected by preparation and return.

ignored.description: Ignored artifact paths whose changes the return procedure restores.

inputs.description: Complete input closure of the environment procedures.

capacity.description: Maximum simultaneous executions supported by this declaration.

additionalProperties.description: Project procedures for candidate execution and return.

jobs.description: [jobs] fills. Known names take a command, list, or { run, timeout } and derive their stage; a custom [jobs.<name>] table requires `stage` and `run`.

format.description: A formatter or codemod. Mutating, so it runs first and serially.

run.description: The command(s) to run. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

scopes.description: [scopes.<name>] tables — a named region defined by `paths`, with optional attributes.

paths.description: The globs that define the scope: a directory prefix (src/**), a standard glob (src/**/*.ext, src/*), a *.ext suffix at any depth, a /seg/ segment, or an exact path. neutral.description: true: changes here need no gate, as for documentation and agent instructions.

preview.description: A read-only command an agent can run from this worktree to preview a change in this scope. discern reports this action but never executes it. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

generated.description: [generated.<name>] tables — committed artifacts, their deterministic regeneration command, and an optional timeout.

paths.description: The scope-paths globs naming the committed artifacts this generator wholly owns: a directory prefix (`reference/**`), a standard glob (`reference/**/*.md`, `reference/*`), a `*.ext` suffix at any depth, a `/seg/` segment, or an exact path. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

run.description: The deterministic command(s) that rewrite this group's artifacts: the same tree must produce the same bytes, and the generator must remove orphaned artifacts it no longer emits. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

linguist_generated.description: true marks the group's paths generated for GitHub through the `linguist-generated` attribute: hidden in diffs by default and excluded from language statistics.

timeout.description: Time budget in seconds for this job alone, replacing [gate].timeout; 0 removes the bound. Omit to inherit the global budget.

standards.description: [standards.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.

metric.description: The metric name the run emits. Defaults to the standard's name.

direction.description: "up" when the value should rise, so the limit is a floor; "down" when it should fall, so the limit is a ceiling.

limit.description: The floor or ceiling, compared with the trunk's: a floor may only rise and a ceiling may only fall.

run.description: This standard's producer command. Emits DISCERN_METRIC <metric> <number>; cannot accompany producer.

producer.description: Consume an existing job, scope gate, or standard producer instead of running a separate producer.

extract.description: Extract readings from captured producer output on stdin; this is a separate operation from run.

artifact.description: Declared producer artifact supplied on stdin to extract; requires extract.

inputs.description: Complete input closure as scope globs; omission binds evidence to the candidate.

needs.description: Producer selectors that must finish successfully before this producer runs.

artifacts.description: Project-relative outputs captured into immutable attempt storage after production.

environment.description: Environment variable names whose effective values enter evidence identity as digests.

toolchain.description: Project-relative identity files for the applicable toolchain.

contexts.description: Required execution contexts for this obligation; omission uses completion.required_contexts.

per.description: Divide the metric to hold a rate rather than a raw count, so the number does not rise because the project grew: a second metric the run emits, or a built-in extent discern measures itself, per = { words = "${map.dir}**" } (files, lines, words, or bytes over a git pathspec). Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

scale.description: Multiply the rate so the limit reads in human units; scale = 1000 reads as per 1,000.

margin.description: Headroom `discern standards --pin` leaves when it tightens the limit to the measured value. Give a metric that drifts on unrelated changes, such as a size or a coverage percentage, a margin so a pinned limit is not tripped by ordinary fluctuation.

timeout.description: Time budget in seconds for this job alone, replacing [gate].timeout; 0 removes the bound. Omit to inherit the global budget.

checkpoints.description: [checkpoints.<name>] tables — change-triggered review rules: trigger fields, mode, and the question the agent judges.

scope.description: Selector: a configured [scopes.<name>] whose paths choose the matched set. Prefer this over repeating the scope's globs in `paths`; a checkpoint takes one selector.

paths.description: Selector globs in the scope dialect: prefix, standard glob, suffix, segment, or exact path. Use either `scope` or `paths`. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

include_generated.description: true includes paths a [generated.<name>] group owns; the default evaluates authored change only.

exclude_paths.description: Globs removed after selection and before every predicate, subject, evidence, and `when`. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

unless_changed.description: Hold fire when any changed path matches one of these globs or scope names: flag this change class unless its counterpart moved too. Registered path references (${map.dir}, ${skills.dir}, ${scripts.dir}, ${project.todo}, ${project.gotchas_doc}) resolve from this config before matching or execution; unregistered braced forms stay untouched.

kinds.description: Narrow changed evidence to the named Git kinds: "added", "modified", or "deleted".

adds_matching.description: Narrow text evidence to files with an added line containing any configured case-sensitive literal UTF-8 byte substring. Accepts up to 16 distinct patterns of 1–128 UTF-8 bytes; NUL, CR, and LF are invalid.

removes_matching.description: Narrow text evidence to files with a removed line containing any configured case-sensitive literal UTF-8 byte substring. Accepts up to 16 distinct patterns of 1–128 UTF-8 bytes; NUL, CR, and LF are invalid.

new_directory.description: Narrow to added files whose parent directory held no admitted file at the merge-base; root-level additions never qualify.

binary.description: Narrow to binary changes when true or text changes when false.

min_changed_files.description: Fire only when at least this many matched files changed. Omit for no threshold (any matched change fires).

min_changed_lines.description: Require this many added-plus-removed text lines across the final narrowed evidence; binary files contribute zero.

deletion_dominant.description: Fire only when the matched change is deletion-dominant: line removals clearly outweigh additions and exceed a fixed floor, so a large cut is reviewed and an ordinary edit or balanced refactor is not.

similar_new_file.description: Fire only when the change adds a file whose name closely resembles an existing sibling in the same directory, the signature of a parallel implementation growing beside the original.

min_commits.description: Require this many commits in merge-base..HEAD, including merge commits; uncommitted work adds no commit.

when.description: Final executable condition: exit 0 fires, exit 10 passes; every other outcome is indeterminate. `DISCERN_MATCH <path>` narrows the structural matches.

mode.description: "stop" (the default): the gate refuses to run until the agent declares the question met or unmet. "advise": the question and its evidence are delivered through the advisory channel and nothing blocks.

question.description: Inline judgment prose. A project checkpoint needs this or `question_file`; a built-in inherits unless overridden. Review surfaces serve it. Do not include secrets.

question_file.description: Repository-relative Markdown path from the governing merge-base Git tree. Mutually exclusive with `question`; built-ins may inherit. Must be a regular Git blob, valid UTF-8, and at most 65536 bytes. Text can appear in terminal, MCP, CI, Proof, and landing review; repository access is its only privacy. Do not include secrets.

teach.description: Optional lesson prose carried into renderings: why the question matters and what good looks like.

reference.description: Optional displayed pointer. discern performs no content loading or execution. Review surfaces may show it. Do not include secrets.

setup.description: Bounded [setup] configuration for setup coverage accounting.

not_applicable.description: Known jobs this project's lifecycle does not have. A job listed here cannot also be configured under [jobs].

worktree.description: Bounded [worktree] configuration for isolated-checkout behavior and resources.

root.description: Where per-worktree checkouts are created. Empty means a sibling of the repository, "<repo>.worktrees", outside the checkout. A relative path resolves against the repo root; absolute is used as-is.

inherit_env.description: Names copied from the main checkout's declared env files. A value fills an empty entry or the first file's `<file>.example` default. A missing first file is created at mode 0600; existing modes stay unchanged.

env_files.description: Env files read and written in order: the last definition wins; new values use the first existing file. Inheritance alone may create the first file. Managed values share one scoped marker.

port.description: Record each worktree's deterministic dev-server port in its env files, for tooling that reads DISCERN_WORKTREE_PORT. `discern identity --port` reports it either way.

ignored_file_drift.description: Track ignored files at worktree setup and report the top-level ignored paths that changed before the worktree is removed. Turn it off when ignored outputs churn too much to be useful.

create.description: Command run once at worktree setup. discern records cleanup intent before running it and skips it only after readiness is recorded. An empty command is a clean no-op.

destroy.description: Command run once at teardown. Author it idempotent (it may re-run via worktree prune) and cwd-independent.

ensure.description: Idempotently reconcile drift or re-readiness at session start.

required.description: false makes a create failure non-fatal, so setup continues.

gc.description: false exempts the resource from orphan pruning, for data-loss-sensitive resources that only teardown may remove.

setup.description: Commands that ready a linked worktree.

steps.description: Commands run once at worktree creation, in order, after the resources exist: one-shot scaffolding such as seeding fixtures.

ensure.description: Commands run on every linked-worktree pass: creation, session start, and after `discern update`. For convergence that depends on worktree identity, ports, or resources; the main checkout never runs them.

description: A bounded version-2 setup recipe consumed only by `discern setup begin --config <file>`. Project identity and setup inputs stay flat; its map, jobs, scopes, generated groups, standards, checkpoints, setup policy, and worktree settings fill discern.toml. Standing acceptance grants remain outside this document. Every field is optional.
